;
; SYNTHETIC alphax.txt excerpt — hand-written for tests, not game data.
;
; The real alphax.txt is copyrighted and is never committed (CONTRIBUTING.md
; §"The Game Fixture"). This file mimics its *shape* and deliberately contains
; every parsing trap the real one does, with invented values:
;
;   - a line-initial comment (this block) before any section
;   - a `;` inside effect text, which must not be treated as a comment
;   - a `,` inside effect text, which breaks fixed-column parsing
;   - `None` (no prerequisite) vs `Disable` (excluded from the game)
;   - secret-project rows carrying five trailing AI-priority ints
;   - trailing commas
;   - a right-to-left flag bit string
;   - INLINE `;` comments, in #RULES and #WORLDBUILDER only, whose own text
;     contains commas — the inverse of the effect-text trap above
;   - two row shapes in one section (#CITIZENS specialists vs. plain citizens)
;   - a #SOC* ladder rung whose description is empty, and asymmetric ladders
;
; A few representative rows per section, not the whole file: the point is the
; shapes, and a fixture that grew to match the source would stop being one.
;
